SUMMARY

Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and end-to-end solution architect with an MBA & M.Sc. in Data Analytics, bringing 12+ years' cross-industry experience across telecom/ISP, BFSI, retail, manufacturing, and education. Design transformation strategies that go beyond point automations to deliver full operating models - pairing technology with the ownership, governance, and customer experience needed to sustain the change. Combines Lean discipline with forward-looking AI and automation thinking to build closed-loop solutions where every rollout has a defined owner, feedback mechanism, and escalation path - creating durable value for both the business and its customers. Builds the KPIs, dashboards, early warning systems, and governance frameworks that turn data into decisions, grounded in Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, and Agile methodologies.
